cases.derivation: Gens 1-4 see 0..3 window items and fence E=1..4 (settle +1). Gen 5 at 4000 sees 4 items with bootMs >= 4000-60000, so it waits until min(bootMs)+T_LATE+1 = 60001. Gen 1's sweep at 60000 removes E1-E3 (settle 60001, priority 2) before gen 5's attempt (priority 3); M = 4, so gen 5 fences E = 5 at 60001 and is confirmed at 60002.
